resources.string:
Colored rings shrink toward the center.

• Tap anywhere to rotate the core 90 degrees clockwise.
• The color under the top white arrow is your active color.
• Match incoming rings with the correct core color.
• One mistake ends the run unless you revive!

The longer you survive, the faster the rings and music get.

Color Frequency v1.0

A fast-paced arcade reflex and rhythm game built with Android Java and Custom Canvas rendering.

Match colors, beat your high score, and enjoy the dynamic procedural soundtrack!

Developed for Android.
